Leave the PLAYING and DEAD input branches, all physics, scoring, daily seed, Profile data, and UI layout unchanged. Implement the minimal guarded condition in existing Godot 4.7 GDScript; do not generate a marker, canary text file or documentation-only change. Do not change tests, dependencies, workflows, secrets or monetization. Use actual Godot 4.7.2 headless parse validation and persist the modified source in a review branch/pull request after verification. design.accessibility: Ensures that users interacting with the settings panel are not unintentionally launched into gameplay, improving touch target safety.
design.direction: In scripts/main.gd, modify _unhandled_input to only call start_run when state == "READY" and settings_open == false.
design.feedback: Taps outside the settings panel while it is open are ignored, preventing accidental game start; the BACK button and all toggles continue to work as before.
design.layout: No changes to UI node hierarchy or positioning.
design.motion: No alteration to animations or physics.
design.responsive_behavior: Input handling remains identical for PLAYING and DEAD states; the fix only affects the READY state when the settings panel is visible.

acceptance_criteria: When settings panel is open (settings_open == true) in READY state, tapping empty space does not start a game.
When settings panel is closed in READY state, tapping empty space starts a game as before.
The BACK button in the settings panel continues to function correctly.
All other input handling (PLAYING, DEAD states) remains unchanged.
